user.title: Enable Banking Setup
user.description:
Enter your Enable Banking API credentials.

**How to get them:**
1. Open [{enablebanking_url}/cp/applications]({enablebanking_url}/cp/applications)
2. Choose **Sandbox** (testing) or **Production**
3. Select **Generate in the browser** for the key
4. Enter an application name (e.g. "Home Assistant Finance")
5. Register exactly this redirect URL: `{redirect_url}`
6. Click **Register** - the private key downloads automatically
7. Copy the **Application ID** from the confirmation page

**Security:** Your credentials are encrypted and stored locally in Home Assistant.

After setup, add your banks via **Add bank** on the Finance integration page.

reconfigure.title: Replace Enable Banking credentials
reconfigure.description:
Enter the new Application ID and private key. Your connected banks stay as they are.

The registered redirect URL must be: `{redirect_url}`

error.invalid_credentials: Enable Banking rejected the credentials (HTTP 401/403). Check that the Application ID matches the private key and the application is activated.
error.connection_failed: Connection to Enable Banking failed. Please check your internet connection.

abort.reconfigure_successful: The Enable Banking credentials were updated.

data.raw_retention_days: Keep raw bank responses for (days, 0 = forever)
data.show_household: Show household budget in the panel

data_description.raw_retention_days: Raw responses are kept encrypted so the data can be re-processed whenever the processing changes. 0 keeps them for life (recommended); otherwise at least 30 days.
data_description.show_household: Hides the household split in the panel when you only track accounts.

refresh_accounts.name: Refresh accounts
refresh_accounts.description: Refresh the list of linked bank accounts from Enable Banking.

refresh_transactions.name: Refresh transactions
refresh_transactions.description: Fetch latest transactions for all linked accounts. Counts against Enable Banking's limit of 4 calls per day per bank.

days.name: Days
days.description: Number of days to fetch (default 90). Older cached transactions are kept.

import_spreadsheet.name: Import household spreadsheet
import_spreadsheet.description: Import a household calculation workbook (.xlsx) into the budget plan. Replaces the current plan. Admin only. The file's directory must be listed in allowlist_external_dirs, or the file must sit in the config directory.

get_transfer_plan.name: Get transfer plan
get_transfer_plan.description: Return the monthly transfer choreography — which amount to move between which accounts, and each person's remaining pocket money.

month.name: Month
month.description: Month number (1-12). Defaults to current month.

get_balance.name: Get balance
get_balance.description: Get current balances for all linked accounts.

get_monthly_summary.name: Get monthly summary
get_monthly_summary.description: Get spending summary grouped by category for a given month.

month.name: Month
month.description: Month number (1-12). Defaults to current month.

categorize_transactions.name: Categorize transactions
categorize_transactions.description: Re-run auto-categorization on all cached transactions.

set_budget_limit.name: Set budget limit
set_budget_limit.description: Set a monthly budget limit for a spending category.

category.name: Category
category.description: The spending category (e.g., housing, food, transport).

toggle_demo.name: Toggle demo mode
toggle_demo.description: Toggle demo mode on/off. Generates realistic synthetic banking data for testing and demonstration.

export_csv.name: Export CSV
export_csv.description: Export transactions as a CSV file for local download.

reprocess_data.name: Re-process bank data
reprocess_data.description: Rebuild the processed transaction history from the encrypted raw bank responses. No bank call; the previous state is kept as a backup.

init.title: Restart Home Assistant
init.description:
Finance has been updated to version {version}. A restart is required to apply the new version.

Finance has been updated to version {version}. Home Assistant must be restarted to apply the update.

Click **Submit** to restart now.

reconfigure_required.title: Finance: Reconfiguration Required
reconfigure_required.description: Finance has switched from GoCardless to Enable Banking. Please reconfigure with your Enable Banking credentials via Settings > Integrations.

credentials_missing.title: Finance: API Credentials Missing
credentials_missing.description: No Enable Banking API credentials are stored. The integration cannot fetch banking data until you reconfigure it via Settings > Devices & Services.

credentials_invalid_pem.title: Finance: Invalid Private Key
credentials_invalid_pem.description: The stored Enable Banking private key could not be loaded. Reconfigure the integration via Settings > Devices & Services and paste the full PEM key including the BEGIN/END lines.

storage_corrupt.title: Finance: Transaction Cache Corrupt
storage_corrupt.description: The transaction cache file `{storage_key}` could not be read ({error_class}). The integration has started with an empty cache. Trigger a manual refresh to repopulate the cache.

init.title: Renew bank connection
init.description:
The connection to **{bank}** expires soon. Renew it now so that balances and transactions keep updating.

Open the Finance integration page ({link}), choose the three-dot menu next to **{bank}** and click **Reconfigure**. You will be redirected to your bank to confirm access again.

abort.continue_in_integrations: Continue on the Finance integration page. This notice disappears once the connection is renewed.
abort.bank_not_found: This bank connection no longer exists.

init.title: Renew bank connection
init.description:
The connection to **{bank}** has expired or was revoked. Balances and transactions cannot be refreshed until you renew it.

Open the Finance integration page ({link}), choose the three-dot menu next to **{bank}** and click **Reconfigure**. You will be redirected to your bank to confirm access again.

abort.continue_in_integrations: Continue on the Finance integration page. This notice disappears once the connection is renewed.
abort.bank_not_found: This bank connection no longer exists.
